# Problem-resolution closeout

Issue: <short name and task/topic identifier>
Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Status: CLOSED

Investigation and cause: PASS — <evidence reviewed and cause established>

Fix: PASS — <changed behavior/files or why no fix was eligible>

Verification: PASS — <commands/tests and observed outcome; include live log/screenshot correlation when eligible>

Future prevention: PASS — <specific prevention step>

Prevention enforcement: PASS — test: <automated regression/test name and how it rejects recurrence>

Use `N/A — <specific reason>` for an ineligible section. A record with any N/A
does not by itself close an issue when that step is required for the requested
outcome. The validator checks completeness and machine-checkable prevention
enforcement; the owner still determines whether the evidence supports closure.
